src: INT. PARAANE PHARMACEUTICAL TRANSFER VAULT – PRE-DAWN / EXT. BHAIGAARA BUFFER FOREST / INT. ANAADHI’S CABIN
END immediately after SEMMAA (O.S.): Get down!; operation detonation is SC066 boundary
env6: SB begins only at 'Parallel Earths invade the room'; six alternatives mutually exclusive; RST02 completes when Anaadhi looks from open-hand version to real hands; zero residue.

locks.anaadhi: 27/193cm/AGE_27_FOREST_PRECAPTURE; imposing; carried self-cut hair; no shaved/topless capture state, PNX4 or ADK7 impairment in SC065
locks.aarathi: B24 field continuity; alone; no sidearm/visible officers; same RUKEY display
locks.display: same RUKEY_seventeen_name_display; exactly 17 names; A->N handoff, N opens/folds/returns, A re-clips rainproof satchel; no fabricated names
locks.pharma: initial 12 PNX-4; restricted override replaces Unit07 only with darker ADK-7; warnings hidden by encrypted clearance; sealed display TWELVE AUTHORISED UNITS; no administration
locks.inner_voice: silent before SB069; no audible/visible manifestation

resolve.duration_rule: 3s each; shot n window=[3(n-1),3n] provisional seconds
resolve.prompt_rule: Exact SC065 screenplay + purpose + resolved camera/binding; photoreal cinematic 3840x1600 2.40:1; never invent unresolved ID/text/design.
resolve.audio_rule: creator-recorded dialogue only; provisional BGM hold; source-action SFX; physical vault/forest/cabin ambience except SB069 represented layer; RST02 restores physical sound

shots: Establish sterile Paraane pharmaceutical transfer vault beneath LOC-003; copper-coded cases on magnetic rails
Operation crate enters scanner; label reads AUTHORISED: PNX-4 STANDARD SEDATIVE
Open case view confirms exactly twelve visually identical PNX-4 cartridges before substitution
Pharmacy Technician scans the crate and checks authorization
Technician turns away to verify the transport seal
Restricted Adraka-linked command enters while technician is turned
Hold exact command text: PRIORITY CLINICAL OVERRIDE; REPLACE UNIT 07; CENTRAL CLEARANCE CONFIRMED
Mechanical arm removes PNX-4 Unit 07; remaining eleven stay untouched
ADK-7 Unit 07 enters replacement slot with darker cartridge metal
Hold exact ADK-7 warnings: RESTRICTED TRANSFER / MEMORY-ASSOCIATION COMPOUND / FIELD USE NOT AUTHORISED
Encrypted clearance layer covers the ADK-7 warnings; do not imply lawful field authorization
Technician notices the batch colour difference after turning back
PHARMACY TECHNICIAN: Why is the batch colour different?
Inventory Assistant relies on system authorization
INVENTORY ASSISTANT: The system says it is authorised.
Inventory Assistant dismisses challenge to central clearance
INVENTORY ASSISTANT: My salary is not high enough to argue with central clearance.
Case is sealed; final display reads TWELVE AUTHORISED UNITS despite one ADK-7 replacement
Transition to Bhaigaara buffer forest before dawn; Aarathi approaches Anaadhi cabin alone
Aarathi carries the same RUKEY_seventeen_name_display from SC063-SC064
Confirm no sidearm and no visible officers around Aarathi
Forest is unnaturally quiet around LOC-001 cabin approach
First hidden black-kite drones appear too early above/through forest concealment
Aarathi recognizes operation activity before surrender confirmation
AARATHI: Unnath, do not start the operation. I have not confirmed surrender.
Communication returns static; no operation attack yet
ANARVAA (V.O.): The operation is already active.
Aarathi rejects the breach of agreement
AARATHI: This is not the agreement.
ANARVAA (V.O.): We do not make agreements with an accused person.
Interior real cabin: exactly seventeen names remain; Anaadhi has not slept
Inner Voice is explicitly silent; hold only physical cabin reality
Drone reflection crosses a covered mirror; do not uncover mirror or show drone inside cabin
Anaadhi moves toward the window, alert but not drug-impaired
Aarathi enters through the open door breathless; no visible weapon
Anaadhi challenges how the location reached them; use exact source recording, no invented text
Aarathi admits she gave them the location
AARATHI: I gave them the location.
Aarathi states she did not approve the operation
AARATHI: I did not approve this operation.
AARATHI: So that there would be no gunfire.
Anaadhi states the consequence of her disclosure
Aarathi says she will demand police custody
AARATHI: I will demand police custody.
Anaadhi accepts honesty over false assurance
ANAADHI: That is better than a false guarantee.
Aarathi physically hands the same portable seventeen-name display to Anaadhi
Anaadhi opens the display; exactly seventeen names remain aligned; no fabricated spellings
Hold on Anaadhi, the real display and his real hands before represented-layer onset
Exact SB069 onset: Parallel Earths invade the room; establish represented layer without multiplying the physical cabin anchor
Alternative 1A: Aarathi leads Anaadhi safely through an empty forest
Alternative 1B: Anaadhi follows with visible open hands; no police presence
Alternative 2A: police fire before Anaadhi reaches the door; represent non-graphically
Alternative 2B: interruption before threshold; no explicit wound mechanics
Alternative 3A: Anaadhi kills everyone outside; represent only restrained implied consequence, no explicit killing mechanics
Alternative 3B: represented exterior threat field remains mutually exclusive from all other alternatives
Alternative 4A: cabin remains undiscovered in an empty forest
Alternative 4B: Anaadhi remains unseen inside untouched cabin; no operation forces
Alternative 5A: twelve-year-old Anaadhi escapes through the lower hatch
Alternative 5B: child disappears into lower passage; do not import SC067 adult escape
Alternative 6A: adult Anaadhi surrenders with open hands
Alternative 6B: open-hand version holds as final mutually exclusive possibility
RST02 trigger: Anaadhi looks from the open-hand version to his real hands
RST02 completes: unchanged WC061 real cabin returns with zero represented residue
Anaadhi folds/closes the portable display after inspecting the aligned seventeen names
Anaadhi returns the same display to Aarathi
Aarathi clips the display into the rainproof inner sleeve of her field satchel
Aarathi urges controlled exit with visible hands and offers to walk first
AARATHI: Come outside with me. Keep your hands visible. I will walk in front.
Aarathi nods; both orient toward the door without crossing into SC066 assault
They move toward the door; no explosion, shield entry, injection or capture mechanics
Exterior rear-stair zone remains quiet before authorised signal
Allied Gangster appears at rear approach before authorised signal
Allied Gangster begins climbing the rear staircase early
Semmaa catches the unauthorized movement from his operation position
Hold spatial relation: gangster on rear stair, Semmaa observing; no attack mechanics
Exact SC065 end hold immediately after Get down!; do not show operation detonating into motion
